answer: Yes, you can sell us a car you still owe money on. While the loan is open, your lender holds the title (or the electronic title record), so you don't need the title in hand, and you don't need a duplicate. At the appointment we confirm what you owe and pay the lender off directly from your offer. If the offer is more than your payoff, you get the difference; if it's less, you pay the difference at the appointment by cashier's check or debit card, so bringing a payoff letter will help speed things up.
